title: VINICIUS SCORES A HAT-TRICK IN 21 MINUTES AND STILL LOOKS FAR FROM HAPPY
description:
One Real Madrid goal in 12 games. Then three in 21 minutes for Brazil.

Vinicius Junior has one Real Madrid goal in 12 games this season. Then came Singapore: three goals in 21 minutes, his first international hat-trick, in a 7-0 win.

Singapore are ranked 148th, and they even chipped in with an own goal. Generous hosts.

And yet Vinicius was substituted early in the second half, and he looked far from happy.

Twelve games, one goal. Twenty-one minutes, three. Maybe it's the Singapore air.

Should he have stayed on after a hat-trick, or was coming off fair? Tell us your side.
